001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
004
005public interface Queue {
006
007    /**
008     * Get the player
009     * @return the player
010     */
011    Player getPlayer();
012
013    /**
014     * Get the duration
015     * @return the duration
016     */
017    int getDuration();
018
019    /**
020     * Get the type
021     * @return the type
022     */
023    boolean isRanked();
024
025    /**
026     * Get the name of the ladder the player is queued for.
027     * @return The ladder name, never null
028     * @since 2.4.0
029     */
030    default String getLadderName() {
031        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Requires ZonePractice Pro with API 2.4.0+");
032    }
033
034}
